verses.t: And he called to Moshe, and Yahweh spoke to him from the Tent of Meeting, saying,

“Speak to the sons of Yisrael and say to them: A person, when he brings near from among y'all a brought near offering to Yahweh: from the animals, from the herd and from the flock, y'all shall bring near y'all's brought near offering.
If his brought near offering is a going up offering from the herd, a whole male he shall bring near; to the entrance of the Tent of Meeting he shall bring it near, for his acceptance before Yahweh.
And he shall lean his hand on the head of the going up offering, and it shall be accepted for him, to cover for him.

And he shall slaughter the son of the herd before Yahweh; and Aharon's sons, the priests, shall bring near the blood and dash the blood against the altar all around, which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
And he shall skin the going up offering and cut it up into its pieces.
And the sons of Aharon the priest shall put fire on the altar and arrange wood on the fire.
And Aharon's sons, the priests, shall arrange the pieces, the head and the fatty pieces, on the wood that is on the fire that is on the altar.
And its entrails and its legs he shall wash in water; and the priest shall turn all of it into smoke on the altar: a going up offering, a fire offering, an aroma of rest to Yahweh.
And if his brought near offering is from the flock, from the young sheep or from the goats, for a going up offering, a whole male he shall bring it near.
And he shall slaughter it on the flank of the altar, northward, before Yahweh; and Aharon's sons, the priests, shall dash its blood against the altar all around.
And he shall cut it up into its pieces, with its head and its fatty pieces, and the priest shall arrange them on the wood that is on the fire that is on the altar.

And the entrails and the legs he shall wash in water; and the priest shall bring all of it near and turn it into smoke on the altar: it is a going up offering, a fire offering, an aroma of rest to Yahweh.
And if his brought near offering to Yahweh is a going up offering from the birds, he shall bring near from the turtledoves or from the young doves his brought near offering.
And the priest shall bring it near to the altar, and pinch off its head and turn it into smoke on the altar; and its blood shall be drained out against the wall of the altar.
And he shall remove its crop with its feathers and throw it beside the altar, eastward, to the place of the ashes.

And he shall split it open by its wings; he shall not sever it. And the priest shall turn it into smoke on the altar, on the wood that is on the fire: it is a going up offering, a fire offering, an aroma of rest to Yahweh.
And a person, when he brings near a brought near offering, a gift offering to Yahweh: fine flour shall his brought near offering be. And he shall pour oil on it and put frankincense on it.

And he shall bring it to Aharon's sons, the priests, and scoop out from there his handful of its fine flour and of its oil, along with all its frankincense; and the priest shall turn into smoke its reminder portion on the altar: a fire offering, an aroma of rest to Yahweh.
And the remainder of the gift offering shall be Aharon's and his sons': most holy, from the fire offerings of Yahweh.

And every brought near offering of your gift offering you shall season with salt; and you shall not let the salt of the covenant of your God rest from upon your gift offering. On every brought near offering of yours you shall bring near salt.
And if his brought near offering is a slaughter offering of well-being offerings: if from the herd he is bringing it near, whether male or female, whole he shall bring it near before Yahweh.

And he shall lean his hand on the head of his brought near offering and slaughter it at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting; and Aharon's sons, the priests, shall dash the blood on the altar all around.
And he shall bring near, from the slaughter offering of well-being offerings, a fire offering to Yahweh: the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,
and the two kidneys and the fat that is on them, which is on the sinews, and the lobe on the liver, with the kidneys he shall remove it.
And Aharon's sons shall turn it into smoke on the altar, on the going up offering that is on the wood that is on the fire: a fire offering, an aroma of rest to Yahweh.

And he shall bring near, from the slaughter offering of well-being offerings, a fire offering to Yahweh: its fat, the fat tail, whole, he shall remove close to the backbone; and the fat that covers the innards and all the fat that is on the innards,
And the priest shall turn it into smoke on the altar: the food of a fire offering to Yahweh.
And the priest shall turn them into smoke on the altar: the food of a fire offering, for an aroma of rest. All fat is Yahweh's.
A lasting statute for your generations, in all your dwellings: y'all shall eat no fat and no blood.
And Yahweh spoke to Moshe, saying:
“Speak to the sons of Yisrael, saying: When a person sins unwittingly from any of Yahweh's commands that are not to be done, and does one of them—
if the anointed priest sins so that guilt falls on the people, he shall bring near, for his sin that he has sinned, a young bull of the herd, whole, to Yahweh as a sin offering.
And the priest shall dip his finger in the blood and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before Yahweh, in front of the curtain of the holy place.

And the priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of fragrant incense before Yahweh, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and all the rest of the bull's blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of the going up offering, which is at the entrance of the Tent of Meeting.
And he shall take out all the bull to outside the camp, to a clean place, to the ash dump, and burn it on wood with fire; at the ash dump it shall be burned.
“And if all the community of Yisrael strays, and the matter is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they do one of all Yahweh's commands that are not to be done, and are guilty —
And he shall do to the bull as he did to the bull of the sin offering, so he shall do to this one; and the priest shall cover for them, and it shall be forgiven them.
And he shall take out the bull to outside the camp and burn it as he burned the first bull: it is the sin offering of the assembly.
“When a chieftain sins, and does unwittingly one of all the commands of Yahweh his God that are not to be done, and is guilty —
And all its fat he shall turn into smoke on the altar, like the fat of the well-being offering; and the priest shall cover for him from his sin, and it shall be forgiven him.
“And if a person from the people of the land sins unwittingly by doing one of Yahweh's commands that are not to be done, and is guilty —

And all its fat he shall remove, as the fat was removed from the well-being offering, and the priest shall turn it into smoke on the altar as an aroma of rest to Yahweh; and the priest shall cover for him, and it shall be forgiven him.
“And if a person sins, in that he hears the voice of an oath-curse, and he is a witness, whether he saw or knew, if he does not tell, he shall bear his iniquity.
And it shall be, when he is guilty of one of these, that he shall confess that in which he has sinned,
and he shall bring to Yahweh his penalty for his sin that he has sinned: a female from the flock, a ewe lamb or a she-goat, as a sin offering; and the priest shall cover for him from his sin.

And if his hand cannot reach enough for a sheep, he shall bring, as his penalty for that in which he has sinned, two turtledoves or two young pigeons to Yahweh, one as a sin offering and one as a going up offering.

“And if his hand cannot reach two turtledoves or two young pigeons, he shall bring as his brought near offering, for that in which he has sinned, a tenth of an ephah of fine flour as a sin offering. He shall put no oil on it and shall not give frankincense on it, for it is a sin offering.

And he shall bring it to the priest, and the priest shall take a handful of it, its full grasp, as its reminder portion, and turn it into smoke on the altar, on Yahweh's fire offerings: it is a sin offering.
And the priest shall cover for him over his sin that he has sinned from one of these, and it shall be forgiven him; and it shall be the priest's, like the gift offering.”
